qualification.correctness_scope: first occurrence of each required bucket plus final step; all private outputs cross-controls, three rows of occurrence0 FP32; not all-step/full-model correctness
qualification.limitation: Timing protocol qualification does not establish all-step correctness or full-model accuracy.

per_layer_minus_shared.interpretation: Observed attention-chain path difference from removing fifteen repeated metadata builds; sharing alone is not this thesis's independent algorithm.

shared_minus_attention_only.interpretation: Graph-outside real-metadata oracle diagnostic. Excluded planning is required dynamic work; the difference is not a pure planner duration or a valid dynamic execution speedup.

legacy_minus_shared.interpretation: Isolated attention-chain difference includes legacy host updates and sink kernel replacement. It does not separate planner savings from attention arithmetic or prove full-model improvement.

planning_budget.planner_endpoint_limitation: Planner wall includes common host descriptor preparation, H2D enqueue, submission and synchronization. It is not the planner kernel cost. Subtracting host preparation still leaves host/device dependency and synchronization costs, rather than pure device computation.
planning_budget.interpretation: The shared baseline has one planner. Incremental scheduling can save only its exposed cost plus measured kernel reductions, minus every added maintenance/copy/synchronization cost. Neither the planner-only wall measurement nor an oracle difference proves achievable exposed savings.

per_layer_minus_shared.interpretation: Numerical scale comparison across different measurement scopes only; not an end-to-end speedup prediction or bound.

shared_minus_attention_only.interpretation: Numerical scale comparison across different measurement scopes only; not an end-to-end speedup prediction or bound.

legacy_minus_shared.interpretation: Numerical scale comparison across different measurement scopes only; not an end-to-end speedup prediction or bound.

timing_boundaries.wall_us: Runner-defined host preparation through final completion; verify the raw runner scope.
timing_boundaries.queue_span_us: External timing events include host launch gaps and dependency waits; not pure kernel time.
timing_boundaries.preparation_enqueue_us: Host enqueue interval; asynchronous device copies need not have completed.
timing_boundaries.submit_join_cpu_us: Runner-defined submission/join interval; do not add it to overlapping queue spans.
timing_boundaries.aggregation: P50/P95/P99 cover step/trial observations. Differences match the same trial and step.

scope: Isolated attention chain; model, serving, TP communication and incremental planner are unmeasured.
